  Government

  ### A world of capability in service of your communities
  
  As a global enterprise, we have a long-established understanding of federal, state, and local
  government needs. By drawing on our vast resources, technology platforms, and differentiated
  expertise, we create effective solutions for the most pressing challenges and provide unparalleled
  support for priority initiatives.

  Manufacturing
  ][118]
  Manufacturing
  [Photo of a technician sanding surface with 3M Xtract sander and personal protective equipment]
  
  ### Making the complex world of manufacturing run smoothly
  
  When it comes to fabricating, assembling or processing anything around the world, 3M knows
  efficiency is key. For you, for your team, and for your bottom line. From ultra-strong abrasives
  that keep processes running seamlessly, to futuristic materials that literally lighten your
  workload, and so much more, innovative 3M solutions help you create what’s next.
  * [Appliance][119]
  * [Bonding & Assembly][120]
  * [Converter Solutions][121]
  * [Defense][122]
  * [Industrial Machinery][123]
  * [Metalworking][124]

  * [Paper & Print][126]
  * [Woodworking][127]

  Safety
  ][128]
  Safety
  [Photo of an industrial worker wearing 3M personal protective equipment]
  
  ### Advancing safe and sound through science
  
  We create safety solutions that help protect people and control their environments across
  industries. From personal protective equipment to infrastructure improvements, our technologies
  help ensure safety in a changing world and allow you to focus on your work with confidence.
  * [Facility Safety][129]
  * [Road Safety][130]
  * [Worker Health & Safety][131]
* [
  Transportation
  ][132]
  Transportation
  [Photo of a commercial airplane parked on an airport tarmac]
  
  ### Helping the world move safely and efficiently
  
  Our science is propelling the transportation industry forward with safer, faster, and lighter
  technologies across the seas, sky, and land. With solutions that can scale from cargo ships to
  scooters, we can help all manufacturers, transporters, and travelers achieve their goals.
  * [Aerospace][133]
  * [Commercial & Specialty Vehicles][134]
  * [Marine][135]
  * [Rail][136]
  * [Road Safety][137]
  * [Vehicle Registration][138]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

day and everywhere.

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

# Altrix Precision Temperature Management

Effective patient warming and cooling are crucial for achieving positive health outcomes. **Altrix**
offers a superior solution for temperature management with precision, versatility, and speed—all
within one easy-to-use system suitable for all clinical setting.

[Talk With A Rep][6]
[
][7]

# One machine.
# `One System.`

### Three water circuits

Simple, self-sealing hose ports eliminate water spillage and maximize performance, efficiency, and
speed to target temperature. All three water circuits can be individually monitored for ease of use.

### Removable water reservoir

Therapy setup is simple and easy, and allows for uninterrupted temperature management while adding
or refilling water with the translucent, removable water reservoir

### Ease of mobility

Altrix was designed with ergonomic support in mind. This usability, alongside its proven durable
features, results in one machine that can easily be maneuvered throughout the entire hospital.

[Talk With A Rep][8]

# One Machine.
# ‍`Universal Temperature Management.`

# Simple.

### Patient graphs

Patient graphs provide information about the patient, target, and water temperature as well as power
levels in order to help effectively analyze treatment.

### Situational help

Situational help offers assistance and guidance in the case of an alarm in order to properly educate
users as to the cause of the alert and how to correct the situation.

### **Fast, easily prompted therapy**

The user-friendly graphic interface makes it easy to initiate patient therapy with just a few simple
taps of the finger. These prompts ensure easy setup, especially during highly critical, low
frequency situations.

# Smart.

### **No aerosolization of bacteria**

Since 2015, the FDA issued three safety communications about a potential association between patient
infections and water-based heater-cooler devices. Nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) might have
aerosolized into the operating room from the devices and caused serious illness and death of

## Introducing Mission Partner

AORN proudly launches its Mission Partner Program, delivering long‑term, purpose‑driven partnerships
that advance perioperative care.

[Learn about Mission Partner][15]

## News & Updates

[Non-descript decorative image tinged green.]

### FAORN Application Now Open

Want to become a Fellow of AORN? The FAORN application is open through Sept. 15. [Learn more about
becoming a Fellow][16].

[Non-descript decorative image tinged teal.]

### Celebrate Nurse Excellence

Nominations are open for AORN's [Award for Excellence][17] and [Individual Achievement Awards][18]
through Sept. 30.

[Non-descript decorative image tinged blue.]

### Comment on Two Guidelines

Public commenting is now open for two Guidelines: Laser Safety and the Implementation of ERAS.
[Share your input][19].

[Non-descript decorative image tinged grey.]

### AORN Congress Last Day

Second House of Delegates: [The gavel was passed to a new president Tuesday][20].


Using evidence-based guidelines, AORN defines the standards that help keep healthcare workers and
surgical patients safe – while also providing education and resources to support high-quality care.

## New to AORN? Try AORN Membership for Just $1


Get 2 months of full access to the most trusted guideline implementation tools, CNE, and 24/7
support from a perioperative community that’s got your back. No risk. Cancel anytime.

[Start Your Trial Today][21]

## Spotlight on Education

**36.4 CH, 36.4 AEU, 9.7 IPCH**

Designed for new and returning labor and delivery nurses who participate in Cesarean section
procedures, this hybrid course provides the necessary clinical foundation for safe surgical
practice.

This online facility subscription provides access to the most current AORN Guidelines for
Perioperative Practice and comes with a complete set of implementation tools and resources to
empower your team to apply standardized techniques facility-wide.

**39.8 CH, 39.8 AEU, 10.8 IPCH**

Periop 101 OR is an online course that prepares novice nurses for the operating room. This OR nurse
training is part of the full Periop 101 Program.

**18.5 CH, 18.5 AEU**

This comprehensive ASC administrator course helps new ambulatory surgery leaders to hit the ground
running. It helps administrators pinpoint and prioritize the most crucial duties in their first year
and provides supporting education to help you tackle these responsibilities like an experienced
administrator.

This course provides an overview of the anatomical and physiological differences between children
and adults and reviews the developmental stages that establish the basis for safe care.

**3.5 CH, 3.5 AEU, 2.5 IPCH**

This interactive course is the ambulatory surgery center (ASC) leader's go-to resource for
navigating the annual ASC Quality Reporting submission, which is vital to the success of your
surgery center.


## AORN Governance

A 12-member Board of Directors, chosen from and elected by the membership, are responsible for the
strategic vision and financial sustainability of AORN.

Members are also elected to the National Nominating Committee, which approves candidates for the
ballot.

Learn more about voting and how to get involved.


Pressure to rush, limited awareness of positioning injury risks, and gaps in equipment are common
reasons these injuries occur. And these injuries, like long-term nerve damage and pressure sores,
are more common than you might think.

When it comes to environmental hygiene in the OR, role confusion remains a persistent challenge. And
it often stems from teams not knowing who is responsible for cleaning what.

## Become a Vendor Partner

We’re stronger together. Medical device companies, healthcare recruiters, and other vendors partner
with AORN through diverse, impactful sponsorship and advertising opportunities.
* Exhibit, sponsor, and reach highly engaged perioperative nurses and leaders at [the largest
  surgical conference in the world][22].
* Implement multi-channel advertising to connect with your target perioperative audience.
* Show your support for the nursing profession with sponsored educational events and guideline
  resources.
* Conduct market research surveys and focus groups to inform your medical device development and
  product enhancements.

## Thank You to Our Mission Partners

Aligned in purpose. Advancing perioperative excelle

## Introducing Mission Partner

AORN proudly launches its Mission Partner Program, delivering long‑term, purpose‑driven partnerships
that advance perioperative care.

[Learn about Mission Partner][15]

## News & Updates

[Non-descript decorative image tinged green.]

### FAORN Application Now Open

Want to become a Fellow of AORN? The FAORN application is open through Sept. 15. [Learn more about
becoming a Fellow][16].

[Non-descript decorative image tinged teal.]

### Celebrate Nurse Excellence

Nominations are open for AORN's [Award for Excellence][17] and [Individual Achievement Awards][18]
through Sept. 30.

[Non-descript decorative image tinged blue.]

### Comment on Two Guidelines

Public commenting is now open for two Guidelines: Laser Safety and the Implementation of ERAS.
[Share your input][19].

[Non-descript decorative image tinged grey.]

### AORN Congress Last Day

Second House of Delegates: [The gavel was passed to a new president Tuesday][20].


Using evidence-based guidelines, AORN defines the standards that help keep healthcare workers and
surgical patients safe – while also providing education and resources to support high-quality care.

## New to AORN? Try AORN Membership for Just $1


Get 2 months of full access to the most trusted guideline implementation tools, CNE, and 24/7
support from a perioperative community that’s got your back. No risk. Cancel anytime.

[Start Your Trial Today][21]

## Spotlight on Education

**36.4 CH, 36.4 AEU, 9.7 IPCH**

Designed for new and returning labor and delivery nurses who participate in Cesarean section
procedures, this hybrid course provides the necessary clinical foundation for safe surgical
practice.

This online facility subscription provides access to the most current AORN Guidelines for
Perioperative Practice and comes with a complete set of implementation tools and resources to
empower your team to apply standardized techniques facility-wide.

**39.8 CH, 39.8 AEU, 10.8 IPCH**

Periop 101 OR is an online course that prepares novice nurses for the operating room. This OR nurse
training is part of the full Periop 101 Program.

**18.5 CH, 18.5 AEU**

This comprehensive ASC administrator course helps new ambulatory surgery leaders to hit the ground
running. It helps administrators pinpoint and prioritize the most crucial duties in their first year
and provides supporting education to help you tackle these responsibilities like an experienced
administrator.

This course provides an overview of the anatomical and physiological differences between children
and adults and reviews the developmental stages that establish the basis for safe care.

**3.5 CH, 3.5 AEU, 2.5 IPCH**

This interactive course is the ambulatory surgery center (ASC) leader's go-to resource for
navigating the annual ASC Quality Reporting submission, which is vital to the success of your
surgery center.


## AORN Governance

A 12-member Board of Directors, chosen from and elected by the membership, are responsible for the
strategic vision and financial sustainability of AORN.

Members are also elected to the National Nominating Committee, which approves candidates for the
ballot.

Learn more about voting and how to get involved.


Pressure to rush, limited awareness of positioning injury risks, and gaps in equipment are common
reasons these injuries occur. And these injuries, like long-term nerve damage and pressure sores,
are more common than you might think.

When it comes to environmental hygiene in the OR, role confusion remains a persistent challenge. And
it often stems from teams not knowing who is responsible for cleaning what.

with AORN through diverse, impactful sponsorship and advertising opportunities.

# Saving Lives.
# Together.

On the front lines of critical care, everything matters. Lives depend upon us—all of us bringing our
best. Our innovative medical devices help you deliver. Belmont’s solutions blend technical
inspiration with an uncompromising quality standard. Because earning your trust is the only option.

When lives are in your hands, reach for Belmont.

## At our best when it matters most.

In developing and refining our leading fluid warming and temperature regulation devices, we strive
to innovate advanced capabilities and patient safety features that give you the power and precision
to change the course of critical outcomes.
* [ BLOOD & FLUID WARMING ][31]
* [ TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT ][32]
* [ HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE ][33]

BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### The Belmont^{®} Rapid Infuser RI-2

Trusted in the most extreme situations for more than 20 years, The Belmont® Rapid Infuser delivers
rapid, reliable, and bubble-free delivery of life-saving warmed blood and fluid at the touch of a
button.
* Precise control of fluid delivery (at rates from 2.5 to 1000 ml per minute)
* Precise, high-speed warming
* Automatic air detection and removal
* Intuitive touchscreen display
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][34]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### buddy lite^{®}

Portable blood and fluid warming—anytime, anywhere—in a remarkably compact, lightweight package,
buddy lite^{®} is used globally by clinicians to help prevent hypothermia during fluid
administration.
* Easy to use
* Close-to-patient warming
* Battery or AC powered
* Military tested and approved
* Aluminum-free disposable

[LEARN MORE][35]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### BloodNav^{™}

MTP Performance Improvement & Automatic Documentation Tool
* Rapidly tracks blood products across all locations
* Calculates ratios to support balanced transfusion goals
* Displays customizable MTP performance improvement prompts
* Provides live web dashboard for blood bank
* Streamlines documentation & integrates with EMRs

[LEARN MORE][36]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### Burn Navigator^{®}

Evidence-based fluid management for severely burned adults and children
* Unique resuscitation graphs
* 24-hour volume projections
* Non-responder detection and alerts
* Customizable protocols
* Inhalation injury guidelines
* EMR connectivity

[LEARN MORE][37]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### Allon^{®}

Safe, simple, and effective, this non-invasive system maintains patient body temperature throughout
all stages of the perioperative continuum. Allon’s algorithm-driven heat pump circulates water
through the ThermoWrap^{®} disposable patient garment.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy-to-use touch-screen interface
* Real-time monitoring and graphical display
* Full range of sizes and configurations

 

[LEARN MORE][38]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### CritiCool^{®}

Maintaining pre-set, targeted body temperature as determined by a physician, this safe, and
effective system is composed of two elements, the CritiCool device and the CureWrap^{®}.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy to use and quick set up
* Real-time monitoring and graphical touch-screen display
* Flexibility and versatility with one-piece body-shaped garments

[LEARN MORE][39]
HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE

### Hyperthermia Pump^{™}

The Hyperthermia Pump raises the temperature of a patient’s thoracic or peritoneal cavity to the
desired target temperature by continuously lavaging it with warmed sterile solution.
* Precise temperature control
* High-efficiency electromagnetic induction warmer
* Automatic air removal
* Easy-to-use touchscreen
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][40]

## Areas of Care

In every area of care, better products result in better outcomes. Patients, their advocates, and
your own people expect the best from you. Belmont solutions blend technical inspiration with
uncompromising quality to give your clinicians added power to affect the course of medical events.
That’s the goal we all share.

# Saving Lives.
# Together.

On the front lines of critical care, everything matters. Lives depend upon us—all of us bringing our
best. Our innovative medical devices help you deliver. Belmont’s solutions blend technical
inspiration with an uncompromising quality standard. Because earning your trust is the only option.

When lives are in your hands, reach for Belmont.

## At our best when it matters most.

In developing and refining our leading fluid warming and temperature regulation devices, we strive
to innovate advanced capabilities and patient safety features that give you the power and precision
to change the course of critical outcomes.
* [ BLOOD & FLUID WARMING ][31]
* [ TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT ][32]
* [ HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE ][33]

BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### The Belmont^{®} Rapid Infuser RI-2

Trusted in the most extreme situations for more than 20 years, The Belmont® Rapid Infuser delivers
rapid, reliable, and bubble-free delivery of life-saving warmed blood and fluid at the touch of a
button.
* Precise control of fluid delivery (at rates from 2.5 to 1000 ml per minute)
* Precise, high-speed warming
* Automatic air detection and removal
* Intuitive touchscreen display
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][34]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### buddy lite^{®}

Portable blood and fluid warming—anytime, anywhere—in a remarkably compact, lightweight package,
buddy lite^{®} is used globally by clinicians to help prevent hypothermia during fluid
administration.
* Easy to use
* Close-to-patient warming
* Battery or AC powered
* Military tested and approved
* Aluminum-free disposable

[LEARN MORE][35]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### BloodNav^{™}

MTP Performance Improvement & Automatic Documentation Tool
* Rapidly tracks blood products across all locations
* Calculates ratios to support balanced transfusion goals
* Displays customizable MTP performance improvement prompts
* Provides live web dashboard for blood bank
* Streamlines documentation & integrates with EMRs

[LEARN MORE][36]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### Burn Navigator^{®}

Evidence-based fluid management for severely burned adults and children
* Unique resuscitation graphs
* 24-hour volume projections
* Non-responder detection and alerts
* Customizable protocols
* Inhalation injury guidelines
* EMR connectivity

[LEARN MORE][37]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### Allon^{®}

Safe, simple, and effective, this non-invasive system maintains patient body temperature throughout
all stages of the perioperative continuum. Allon’s algorithm-driven heat pump circulates water
through the ThermoWrap^{®} disposable patient garment.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy-to-use touch-screen interface
* Real-time monitoring and graphical display
* Full range of sizes and configurations

 

[LEARN MORE][38]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### CritiCool^{®}

Maintaining pre-set, targeted body temperature as determined by a physician, this safe, and
effective system is composed of two elements, the CritiCool device and the CureWrap^{®}.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy to use and quick set up
* Real-time monitoring and graphical touch-screen display
* Flexibility and versatility with one-piece body-shaped garments

[LEARN MORE][39]
HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE

### Hyperthermia Pump^{™}

The Hyperthermia Pump raises the temperature of a patient’s thoracic or peritoneal cavity to the
desired target temperature by continuously lavaging it with warmed sterile solution.
* Precise temperature control
* High-efficiency electromagnetic induction warmer
* Automatic air removal
* Easy-to-use touchscreen
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][40]

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

As pharma innovators, your CDMO partner must bring the expertise, scale, and regulatory strength to

facility expertise, we deliver true end-to-end services across the complete drug lifecycle, from
drug substance to drug product. Our integrated capabilities and expanded capacity enable consistent
execution, supporting development, clinical supply, and large-scale commercial manufacturing with

### APIs

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

#### Sustainability

Humanity is now facing major social issues such as global warming and resource depletion. Under the
slogan of "Supporting the world with technology," the EBARA Group is working to solve a wide range
of social issues and contribute to the sustainable development of the earth and society through the
technological capabilities and passion it has cultivated over the years, as well as various
solutions.

[View Sustainability][198]

#### Innovation Story

Ebara was founded in 1912 as a venture company originating from a university. Since that time, in
order to meet the needs of society and customers, we have boldly taken on challenges in the spirit
of "passion and sincerity" even in unknown areas. This spirit of innovation has been inherited to
the present day, and we continue to provide new value to the world by sincerely responding to the
diversifying needs of our customers, contributing to the resolution of social issues.

[See the innovation story][199]
[ [YouTube video:Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World] ][200]

## Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

The EBARA Group has supported the ever-changing industry and social infrastructure, as well as the
evolving information society, with technologies that create the "flow" of water, air, electronics,
and energy. From now on, we will continue to create new "flows" that are needed in a changing world,
and create a better future full of rich smiles.

technological capabilities and passion it has cultivated over the years, as well as various

Ebara was founded in 1912 as a venture company originating from a university. Since that time, in
order to meet the needs of society and customers, we have boldly taken on challenges in the spirit

the present day, and we continue to provide new value to the world by sincerely responding to the

# EM-MED Temperature Management Products

Exact temperature makes a big difference.

**We are specialists in patient temperature management**. In our offer you will find a range of
devices that enable reaching and accurately maintaining the required patient temperature.

[produkty banner]

## [EmTherm®
## warming cabinets][10]

[ [emtherm] ][11]

## [TrueCool®
## therapeutic hypothermia TTM][12]

[ [truecool] ][13]

At **EM-MED**, we design and deliver advanced [**therapeutic hypothermia devices**][14] and [**IV
fluid warmers**][15] that help hospitals maintain precise patient temperature control in critical
care settings. Our smart temperature management systems support optimal outcomes in surgery,
intensive care, and emergency medicine.

Our **IV fluid warming cabinets** safely and efficiently heat intravenous fluids, irrigation
solutions, and medical blankets, ensuring every patient receives warm, ready-to-use materials during
procedures. The **TrueCool® Therapeutic Hypothermia Device** provides rapid cooling, precise
temperature regulation, and safe, controlled rewarming for patients requiring targeted temperature
management after cardiac arrest or neurological injury.

With over **30 years of experience** and trusted by hospitals in **more than 30 countries**, EM-MED
delivers **certified, reliable, and user-friendly temperature management solutions** designed for
modern healthcare environments.

Choose EM-MED’s innovative **therapeutic hypothermia devices** and **IV fluid warmers** to enhance
patient safety, reduce complications, and support better clinical outcomes across every stage of
care.

# Full-Stack EV Infrastructure. National Execution.

Energy5 delivers complete EV charging infrastructure solutions — from early-stage planning and
incentive strategy to engineering, construction, and long-term operation.

We don't just install chargers. We design infrastructure that performs in real-world conditions,
aligns with long-term ROI, and scales across portfolios.

[Start Project][6][Partner With Us][7]

What We Do

## EV Charging Infrastructure, Built End-to-End

Energy5 manages the full lifecycle of EV charging projects, eliminating fragmentation and reducing
risk.

### Coordinated Structure

From site evaluation to live operational chargers, every step is handled within one structure. This
reduces delays, simplifies communication, and ensures accountability.

### Incentive Strategy Built-In

EV charging is a financial model. We integrate utility rebates, state funding, and federal
incentives into design, capturing funding without compromising quality.

### National Execution

Execution is where most fail. Supported by Utilities One Power Delivery, we deliver at scale
nationally with experienced crews and utility coordination expertise.

Why Energy5

## Built for the Reality of EV Infrastructure

The EV charging market is shifting from early adoption to large-scale deployment. At this stage,
success is no longer defined by how many chargers are installed — it is defined by whether those
systems perform reliably, generate returns, and integrate effectively with the grid.

#### Actual Usage Patterns

Designing infrastructure based on real-world needs and avoiding overbuilt or underutilized systems.

#### Long-term Economics

Aligning incentives directly with long-term economic performance and ROI.

#### Full Accountability

Delivering projects with complete execution accountability from start to finish.

[EV Charging Installation]

One Principle:

Infrastructure must work beyond installation day.

## Two Pathways to Success

01

### For Businesses

Deploy EV charging infrastructure that aligns with your business objectives. We help property
owners, fleet operators, and real estate developers.
* Evaluate site feasibility and infrastructure requirements
* Reduce capital costs through structured incentive strategies
* Implement systems designed for long-term reliability and ROI

[Start Project][8]
02

### For Partners

Scale EV infrastructure without building internal execution capabilities. We provide turnkey
delivery, white-label construction, and incentive support.
* Charge point operators (CPOs)
* Developers and portfolio owners
* EV networks and infrastructure platforms

[Partner With Us][9]

Execution Powered By

[[Utilities One Group]][10]

This combination of strategy and execution ensures projects are delivered consistently, efficiently,
and at national scale.

“Let's build EV infrastructure that works.”

Our Story

[Who We Are]

Gentherm is a global leader with decades of expertise in advanced thermal management, pneumatic
comfort technologies and fluid systems. Our journey began in the automotive sector, where we
pioneered advanced solutions that have become a standard expectation for consumers. Leveraging this
deep-rooted experience, we continue to invest in next-generation technologies where we develop smart
and reliable solutions that expand what’s possible for both existing and growth markets that we
serve.

Our heating technologies use conductive, convective and radiant methods to deliver advanced thermal
solutions that enhance comfort, safety and performance across industries.

Our cooling and ventilation technologies redefine the industry with intelligent airflow systems that
optimize energy efficiency, comfort and customer needs.

Our pneumatic massage systems are powered by first to market Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) valve
technology and deliver ultra-compact, energy-efficient comfort with scientifically optimized pulse
patterns and lifelike massage experiences for wellness, recovery and relaxation across any
environment.

Our advanced valve systems feature Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) actuation and precision injection
molding, which deliver lightweight, modular and energy-efficient solutions for fuel management,
engine control, braking performance and thermal regulation across conventional, hybrid and electric
vehicles.

A local, family-owned HVAC company serving Rochester and surrounding areas.

Green Guys Mechanical was founded to bring professional, honest geothermal and heat pump expertise

targeted comfort zones. Easy to install, easy to use.

upgrade options. 24/7 availability.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Browse practical answers to the questions homeowners ask most about heating, cooling, rebates, and
system upgrades.
* ### Do cold climate heat pumps work in Rochester, NY winters?
  
  Yes. Cold climate heat pumps are designed to handle low outdoor temperatures and can be a strong
  option for many Rochester-area homes. The right fit depends on your home’s size, insulation,
  ductwork, and comfort goals.
* ### What is the difference between a geothermal system and an air source heat pump?
  
  A geothermal system transfers heat through the ground, while an air source heat pump transfers
  heat using outdoor air. Both can heat and cool a home, but the right choice depends on your
  property, budget, and long-term goals.
* ### How do I know if my HVAC system needs replacing?
  
  If your system is older, breaking down often, struggling to keep rooms comfortable, or driving up
  energy bills, it may be time to compare replacement options. A professional evaluation can help
  you decide whether repair or replacement makes more sense.
* ### How much does heat pump installation cost in Rochester, NY?
  
  Heat pump installation cost depends on the type of system, the size of the home, existing
  ductwork, electrical needs, and whether you choose ducted or ductless equipment. The best way to
  get an accurate number is with a home-specific estimate.
* ### Do you offer heat pump repair in Rochester, NY?
  
  Yes. Green Guys Mechanical provides heat pump repair for homeowners dealing with poor performance,
  no heat, strange noises, or cold-weather issues. If your system is not keeping up, it helps to
  have it checked before the problem gets worse.
* ### Do you install ductless mini-splits in Rochester-area homes?
  
  Yes. Ductless mini-splits are a good option for additions, older homes, bonus rooms, and spaces
  that need better temperature control. They can also work well for homeowners who want efficient
  heating and cooling without full ductwork changes.
* ### What should I expect during geothermal heating installation in Rochester, NY?
  
  Geothermal installation usually starts with a site evaluation, system design, and planning for the
  ground loop and indoor equipment. The exact process depends on the property, but homeowners should
  expect a more involved project than a standard equipment replacement.
* ### What areas do you serve around Rochester?
  
  Green Guys Mechanical serves Rochester, Ontario, Webster, Mendon, Honeoye Falls, Pittsford, and
  nearby New York communities. If you are in the surrounding area, it is worth reaching out to
  confirm service availability.

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming and Grounding?

### [OR Today: Augustine Surgical Combines Patient Warming with Electrosurgical Grounding][90]

“Augustine Surgical’s entire HotDog [Patient] Warming Mattress is now also a return electrode, a
required component in electrosurgery that is performed in roughly 4 out of 5 surgeries…Reusable
capacitive return electrodes have been used for 20-plus years in more than 100 million procedures,
however, this is the first time this function has been combined with active patient warming.” [Read
more about warming and grounding][91]

### [Outpatient Surgery: Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the OR][92]

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilized, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.” [Read more about waste heat][93]

### [Outpatient Surgery: Hypothermia is a Concern in Robotic Surgeries][94]

“The relationship between robotic surgery and inadvertent perioperative hypothermia is the subject
of increased investigation. Minimally invasive robotic surgeries were assumed to provide less risk
of losing normothermia than traditional open surgeries, but that assumption has been called into
question.” [Read more about hypothermia in robotics][95]

### [AORN Journal: Implementation of Resistive Warmers for Total Joint Arthroplasty Procedures][96]

“During Surgery, active patient warming is important because of the potential for the patient to
lose heat. There are multiple actors that can affect a patient’s core body temperature during
surgery. Conduction heat loss occurs when heat is transferred through physical contact with an
object, such as a cold operating table.” [Read more about resistive warmers][97]

[**What is HotDog?**][78]

## The Complete Temperature Management and Return Electrode Package

[2-in-1 Patient Warming and Grounding Mattress (Model U502) on Operating Table with Temperature
Management System and Electrosurgical Generator]

### [Air-Free][80]

HotDog utilizes a unique **conductive fabric** called ThermAssure® which emits no waste heat.
Forced-air warming systems have been shown to contaminate the air of the sterile field when their
waste heat carries foreign particles to the surgical site.

**[Learn More >][81]**

### [Better Warming][82]

Warm from **above** and **below** the patient at the same time. HotDog is the only technology with
both blankets and mattresses. This gives it tremendous versatility and effectiveness for many
procedures.

**[Learn More >][83]**

### [Cost Effective][84]

Implement HotDog with **no up-front costs** and immediate cost savings. Decrease your cost of care.
Normothermic patients have better outcomes which lead to shorter hospital stays and faster operating
room turnover rates.

**[Learn More >][85]**

### [Return Electrode][86]

HotDog U5XX Warming Mattresses + Return Electrode combine electrosurgical grounding and underbody
warming into a **two-in-one device**. This “game-changing solution” causes procedures to be set up
in less time, with better outcomes, for less cost.

**[Learn More >][87]**

## What is HotDog?

[HotDog Air-Free Patient Warming Logo]

HotDog’s reusable, air-free patient warming system maintains normothermia without forced-air risks
and waste. A central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming
devices.

Efficient warming is then delivered by a flexible, lightweight conductive polymer fabric inside of
HotDog Blankets and Mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems while also acting as a return electrode.

HotDog is the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and below
simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective warming
solution before, during, and after surgery.

**[Learn More >][88]**

**[Get a Free Quote >][89]**

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming and Grounding?

### [OR Today: Augustine Surgical Combines Patient Warming with Electrosurgical Grounding][90]

“Augustine Surgical’s entire HotDog [Patient] Warming Mattress is now also a return electrode, a
required component in electrosurgery that is performed in roughly 4 out of 5 surgeries…Reusable
capacitive return electrodes have been used for 20-plus years in more than 100 million procedures,
however, this is the first time this function has been combined with active patient warming.” [Read
more about warming and grounding][91]

### [Outpatient Surgery: Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the OR][92]

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilized, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.” [Read more about waste heat][93]

### [Outpatient Surgery: Hypothermia is a Concern in Robotic Surgeries][94]

“The relationship between robotic surgery and inadvertent perioperative hypothermia is the subject
of increased investigation. Minimally invasive robotic surgeries were assumed to provide less risk
of losing normothermia than traditional open surgeries, but that assumption has been called into
question.” [Read more about hypothermia in robotics][95]

### [AORN Journal: Implementation of Resistive Warmers for Total Joint Arthroplasty Procedures][96]

“During Surgery, active patient warming is important because of the potential for the patient to
lose heat. There are multiple actors that can affect a patient’s core body temperature during
surgery. Conduction heat loss occurs when heat is transferred through physical contact with an
object, such as a cold operating table.” [Read more about resistive warmers][97]

Pulling into the parking lot before most of the world is even awake.
Or walking out under the stars at the end of a 12-hour shift.

No matter who you are:
Clinician, caregiver or administrator, you carry a heavy load.
The weight of decisions. Of team members. Of patients and families.
Of why you got into this in the first place.

### 
### ICU MEDICAL

## WE SEE YOU

## And we build for you.

Every tool is designed to meet the real-world demands of every shift, every patient, every moment.
They're made to simplify complexity. To streamline workflows. To help reduce risks before they
happen. To support decisions under pressure.

##### All so you can be present, move with purpose and precision and do what you do best.

[ View Products ][187]

### From IV lines to vital signs, we're with you at the heart of care.
* [
  Products
  Infusion Therapy
  
  From catheters to pumps, you can standardize without clinical compromise, so every drop reaches
  patients safely and every shift runs smoother.
  
  ][188]
* [
  Products
  Pharmacy Preparation
  
  Compounding automation, closed system transfer devices, and IV safety software built to give you
  less pressure and more performance.
  
  ][189]
* [
  Products
  Airway Management
  
  From tracheostomy tubes to breathing support, our tools are designed to make every breath count
  and help everyone breathe a little easier.
  
  ][190]
* [
  Products
  Hemodynamic Monitoring
  
  Monitoring technologies that bring clarity to critical decisions without slowing you down.
  
  ][191]
* [
  Products
  Temperature Management
  
  From fluid warming to temperature probes, we help you protect patients perioperatively, so they
  stay safe and stable in your care.
  
  ][192]
* [
  Products
  Renal Care
  
  Help protect hemodialysis catheters, reduce infection risks, and build the trust that renal care
  depends on.
  
  ][193]
* [
  Products
  Pain Management
  
  From spinal and epidural to regional blocks and diagnostic trays, we give you the right tools to
  ease pain and deliver comfort with confidence.
  
  ][194]

[IV Precision Pump Family]

### Introducing the IV Performance Platform

Lead a new wave of IV therapy performance with an intuitive platform designed to help bring safety,
simplicity, and clarity to patient care. Comprised of Plum Duo^{™} and Plum Solo^{™}* precision IV
pumps and LifeShield^{™} IV safety software, this fully IV-EHR interoperable, future-ready platform
empowers you to raise the performance of your IV therapy practice—helping to enhance safety and
efficiency across all IV touchpoints.

*Plum Duo v1.2 and Plum Solo v1.0

[ Explore the New Wave of IV Safety ][195]

## Latest news

Stay up to date with our latest news
* [
  News / Sep 18, 2025
  ICU Medical Announces New FDA 510(k) cleared labeling claims for Clave^{™} Portfolio of Needlefree
  IV Connectors with Powerful New Infection Control Data
  New labeling clearance highlights peer-reviewed evidence showing hospitals that standardize on
  Clave technology achieve significantly greater infection reduction and cost savings compared to
  non-Clave hospitals.
  ][196]
* [
  News / May 15, 2025
  ICU Medical and VisionHealth Launch MyAcapella^{™} Digital OPEP Coach to Improve OPEP Therapy and
  Adherence for Respiratory Patients
  New digital coaching app enhances patient experience and clinician oversight through guided
  therapy, reminders, and adherence tracking.
  ][197]
* [
  News / May 01, 2025
  ICU Medical, Inc. and Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, Inc. Complete Joint Venture to Bolster IV
  Solutions Manufacturing and Innovation in North America
  The partnership creates one of the largest global IV solutions manufacturing networks with
  combined production of an estimated 1.4 billion annual units and aims to bring additional supply
  chain resiliency and new innovation to the North American IV solutions market.
  ][198]
* [
  News / Apr 07, 2025
  ICU Medical Introduces Its New Category of Infusion Devices With FDA Clearances of Plum Solo^{™}
  and Plum Duo^{™} Precision IV Pumps
  New devices address infusion delivery variability and expand ICU Medical IV Performance Platform
  ][199]

Pulling into the parking lot before most of the world is even awake.
Or walking out under the stars at the end of a 12-hour shift.

No matter who you are:
Clinician, caregiver or administrator, you carry a heavy load.
The weight of decisions. Of team members. Of patients and families.
Of why you got into this in the first place.

### 
### ICU MEDICAL

## WE SEE YOU

## And we build for you.

Every tool is designed to meet the real-world demands of every shift, every patient, every moment.
They're made to simplify complexity. To streamline workflows. To help reduce risks before they
happen. To support decisions under pressure.

##### All so you can be present, move with purpose and precision and do what you do best.

simplicity, and clarity to patient care. Comprised of Plum Duo^{™} and Plum Solo^{™}* precision IV

efficiency across all IV touchpoints.

blankets and mattresses. This gives it tremendous versatility and effectiveness for many procedures.

## What is HotDog?

HotDog Patient Warming is an air-free, water-free, perioperative temperature management system. A
central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming devices.
Efficient warming is then delivered by a flexible, lightweight conductive polymer fabric inside of
HotDog blankets and mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems. It’s the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and
below simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective
warming solution before, during, and after surgery.

#### Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the Operating Theatre

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilised, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.”

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

[toss ins 16ct aqua kem resized]

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

[ Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins® ][67]
[Thetford Aqua Magic VI Homepage Banner]

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

[ Aqua-Magic® VI ][68]
[Titan Tote 4 wheel Airstream Homepage Banner]

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

[ Portable totes ][69]

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

[toss ins 16ct aqua kem resized]

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

[ Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins® ][67]
[Thetford Aqua Magic VI Homepage Banner]

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

[ Aqua-Magic® VI ][68]
[Titan Tote 4 wheel Airstream Homepage Banner]

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

## How can we help you?

### Operating room

In the operating room, where precision and reliability are paramount, our solutions bring effortless
improvements in care. Our solutions are designed to support surgical teams, with warming devices and
bronchoscopes that ensure patient stability and enhance procedural safety, helping you achieve the
best outcomes in every surgery.

### Intensive care unit

Our integrated solutions include advanced temperature management systems, precise fluid and blood
warming devices, and single-use bronchoscopes, all designed to enhance patient care. These solutions
support ICU teams in delivering optimal treatment, improving outcomes, and supporting patient safety
in critical moments.

[ Read more ][40]
[ Read more ][41]

### Emergency department

In the emergency room, rapid and accurate care is crucial. Patient warming technology ensures that
interventions are delivered at optimal temperatures, preventing hypothermia and improving patient

### About

**Zoom Earth** is an interactive weather map of the world.

Explore the current weather and detailed forecasts for your location with stunning, interactive maps
showing rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With **Zoom Earth** you can track the development of hurricanes and storms, monitor wildfires and
smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery and rain radar updated
in near real time.

#### Mobile App

[[App]][1] [[QR]][2]

Download the [**Zoom Earth**][3] app!

**Scan the QR code** with the camera on your mobile device to get the **Zoom Earth** app.

Available on the [App Store][4] for iPhone and iPad, and on [Google Play][5] for Android.

#### Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD [ICON][6] and
NOAA/NCEP/NWS [GFS][7].

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological [sources][8] around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by [NOAA GOES][9], [EUMETSAT Meteosat][10], and [JMA
Himawari][11] geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites [Aqua][12] and
[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

Map labels © [OpenStreetMap][25] contributors.

#### Contact

Please use our [contact form][26] to send us your comments, questions, or suggestions.

© 2026 Neave Interactive Ltd.

[Terms of Service][27]

[Privacy Policy][28]

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.

Yes, I Understand

Track the weather in real time with the **Zoom Earth** app.

[ Download App ][29] Continue

Welcome! Let’s start by finding your location on the map.

### About

**Zoom Earth** is an interactive weather map of the world.

Explore the current weather and detailed forecasts for your location with stunning, interactive maps
showing rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With **Zoom Earth** you can track the development of hurricanes and storms, monitor wildfires and
smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery and rain radar updated
in near real time.

#### Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD [ICON][6] and
NOAA/NCEP/NWS [GFS][7].

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological [sources][8] around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by [NOAA GOES][9], [EUMETSAT Meteosat][10], and [JMA
Himawari][11] geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites [Aqua][12] and
[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.
